title: Raccoon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 42 Q66 55 58 68' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#FF4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='14' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#FF7799' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Balloon shine -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='22' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#FF99AA' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='60,43 64,43 62,46' fill='#CC2244'/>
  
  <!-- Raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#8B8B9E'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#BFBFCC'/>
  
  <!-- Raccoon arms -->
  <!-- Left arm raised holding balloon -->
  <path d='M54 68 Q60 60 60 54' stroke='#8B8B9E' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 68 Q60 60 60 54' stroke='#9E9EB0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M30 70 Q22 75 20 82' stroke='#8B8B9E' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='53' r='4' fill='#6B6B7E'/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6B6B7E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6B6B7E'/>
  
  <!-- Raccoon head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='16' fill='#9E9EB0'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='30,36 26,22 38,32' fill='#7B7B8E'/>
  <polygon points='32,34 29,25 36,32' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <polygon points='54,36 58,22 46,32' fill='#7B7B8E'/>
  <polygon points='52,34 55,25 48,32' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  
  <!-- Mask (dark area around eyes) -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#4A4A5C'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes (white with pupils) -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='45' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='45' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#2A2A3A'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#2A2A3A'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3A3A4C'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='51.5' rx='1' ry='0.8' fill='#6A6A7C'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M42 54.5 Q39 57 37 55' stroke='#3A3A4C' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 54.5 Q45 57 47 55' stroke='#3A3A4C' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- White face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#BFBFCC'/>
  
  <!-- Stripes on tail (behind body) -->
  <g>
    <path d='M22 80 Q14 84 10 78' stroke='#6B6B7E' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M22 80 Q14 84 10 78' stroke='#9E9EB0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='3 4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
